description: Register an agent, make its signing key on this machine, publish the public half (signed with the key, which proves it is held), and keep the private key in a file only this user can read. Answers the agent, its key id, its directory and the key file — never the key. The agent signs its requests with that file: `agentFromKeyFile(path)` in @pidgeon-ai/sdk/node, or PIDGEON_AGENT_KEY (the file’s private_jwk) and PIDGEON_DIRECTORY anywhere else.
